message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"cram/cram_io.c","function":"cram_read_SAM_hdr","line":4627,"var":"b","code":"if (cram_uncompress_block(b) != 0) {","note":"The first CRAM data block is decompressed before the header is parsed, so any corruption in the block contents reaches the decoder."},
  {"step":2,"file":"cram/cram_io.c","function":"cram_uncompress_block","line":1565,"var":"b->method","code":"switch (b->method) { ... case TOK3: { uint32_t out_len; uint8_t *cp = decode_names(b->data, b->comp_size, &out_len); ... free(b->data); b->data = cp; ... }","note":"For TOK3 blocks, the compressed name payload is handed to decode_names, which allocates a replacement buffer and frees the original block data."},
  {"step":3,"file":"htscodecs/htscodecs/tokenise_name3.c","function":"decode_names","line":1531,"var":"in","code":"uint8_t *decode_names(uint8_t *in, uint32_t sz, uint32_t *out_len)","note":"The attacker-controlled TOK3 byte stream is decoded into a new names buffer; malformed token streams can drive incorrect allocation and lifetime handling in the decoder."},
  {"step":4,"file":"htscodecs/htscodecs/tokenise_name3.c","function":"decode_names","line":null,"var":"decoded output buffer","code":"decoder reconstructs name strings and returns a heap buffer to the caller","note":"The returned buffer is consumed by cram_uncompress_block, which assumes ownership transfer and frees the old block data before replacing it."},
  {"step":5,"file":"cram/cram_io.c","function":"cram_uncompress_block","line":1719,"var":"b->data","code":"free(b->data); b->data = cp;","note":"The block's original heap buffer is freed after decode_names returns, and the decoder output becomes the new block storage."},
  {"step":6,"file":"cram/cram_io.c","function":"cram_read_SAM_hdr","line":4627,"var":"b","code":"if (cram_uncompress_block(b) != 0) {","note":"The same block is then used to extract the SAM header, so any decoder-induced corruption affects subsequent header processing."},
  {"step":7,"file":"cram/cram_io.c","function":"cram_read_SAM_hdr","line":4638,"var":"b","code":"if (-1 == int32_get_blk(b, &header_len) || ... ) {","note":"Header parsing reads from the decompressed block contents, which can trigger use-after-free or double-free consequences if the decoder returned an invalid or aliased buffer."}
]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true` executed with exit code 0.
